preconditions.description: The number of points in the initial set is between 1 and 10,000, inclusive.
The given set of points contains no duplicate points.
The coordinates of each point are within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The size of the good superset is between n and 200,000, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: All points in the superset are integers and have absolute values not exceeding 10^9.
postconditions.description: The points in the superset must have integer coordinates and their absolute values must be within the range of -1,000,000,000 to 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: The superset is good according to the given definition
postconditions.description: For any two points in the superset, at least one of the three conditions for being 'good' is true.
